definition.title: Where ARIES thinks
definition.description: 'local' enables the local model. Separate cloud_enabled policy controls explicit foreground escalation; background workers remain local. 'none' switches language models off entirely; ARIES keeps every deterministic capability.

definition.title: The local model
definition.description: Which model the configured local runtime should use. It must exist — ARIES will not download several gigabytes without being asked.

definition.title: Where the local model answers
definition.description: Local runtime address. Only literal loopback URLs are accepted, preventing access from the network.

definition.title: Gateway Enabled
definition.description: Use the persistent local gateway; direct local fallback on gateway outage only.

definition.title: Cloud Enabled
definition.description: Explicit opt-in to send foreground tasks/context to configured cloud endpoint.

definition.title: Local Confidence Threshold
definition.description: Below this confidence recommend cloud; policy still controls network access.

definition.title: Agent demo directory
definition.description: The explicit ARIES demo directory named in user goals. Create it before the demo.

definition.title: Use the ARIES browser for website commands
definition.description: Open public websites in a dedicated visible session with DOM evidence. Turning this off uses the desktop's default browser.

definition.title: Temperature
definition.description: How much the model gambles on less likely words. 0 is repeatable and literal; around 0.7 is conversational; above 1.2 it invents. Structured extraction and routing decisions are more reliable low.

definition.title: Top-p (nucleus)
definition.description: Keeps only the most likely words whose probabilities add up to this fraction. 1.0 considers everything; 0.5 keeps the model on the obvious path. Temperature is the dial to try first — this one mostly matters above temperature 1.

definition.title: Context window
definition.description: How much conversation and document text the local model may hold at once. Larger remembers more but costs video memory and reloads the model; the local runtime, not ARIES, decides what it can fit.

definition.title: Maximum answer length
definition.description: Longest answer the local model may produce in one turn. Lower it for terse replies and faster responses; a task that needs more than it gets fails loudly rather than returning a truncated answer.

ARIES_CAP_TOPK.governs: the planner is sent the most relevant capabilities, not all of them

ARIES_COMPLETION_PROGRESS_GUARD.governs: stop after two rejected completion proposals without an intervening action; preserve one correction opportunity

ARIES_CONTEXT_ENGINE.governs: select memory, recent task history and permitted cached news with provenance, expiry and explicit missing-source coverage

ARIES_CONTRACT_FINISH.governs: propose completion without another model call when every ordered goal condition has verified evidence; fresh independent recheck still required

ARIES_GOAL_TEAMS.governs: decompose eligible goals into scoped temporary read-only runtime agents in the existing queue

ARIES_MK_FROZEN.governs: Macedonian is frozen: it keeps working and keeps being tested, and nothing new is built on it

ARIES_PLAN_MEMORY.governs: relevant remembered facts are injected into planning

ARIES_ROUTER_ABSTAIN.governs: the router may answer ASK or OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than choosing the nearest action; off restores the pre-2026-10-03 instruction to pick the nearest one regardless

ARIES_STATE_SNAPSHOT.governs: the planner is given the current desktop state before it plans

ARIES_TERMINAL_READ_FAILURE.governs: stop repeated model planning after an actual nonretryable missing-file error for the exact single requested read

ARIES_TILE_HIDPI.governs: desktop.tile reads the monitor's scale factor from Mutter and expects the device-pixel-aligned rectangle, so a correct tile on a fractionally scaled display is not reported unverified

ARIES_TRACE_FEWSHOT.governs: similar past successful plans are offered to the planner

ARIES_TYPE_STRICT.governs: input.type_text refuses any case that would silently lose characters — a NUL, a filtered control character, a line break into a single-line control, a rejected or partially landed write — instead of returning a success carrying landed=false

ARIES_VERIFY_FEEDBACK.governs: the planner is told whether each past step's effect was INDEPENDENTLY OBSERVED, not merely whether the tool returned. Off leaves the loop, the retry policy and the step history untouched and removes only that — the one variable in the state-verification-feedback experiment

metrics.binary_accuracy: Fixed 225. actionable correct iff valid nonfallback intent not ASK/OUT_OF_SCOPE/UNKNOWN; other classes correct iff valid nonfallback intent ASK/OUT_OF_SCOPE/UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN is nonaction, not deliberate refusal. Errors always wrong.
metrics.explicit_abstention: ASK or OUT_OF_SCOPE only; precision = justified nonaction-class abstentions / all explicit abstentions; recall on 125 nonaction cases.
metrics.ood_recall: OUT_OF_SCOPE intent on the fixed 40 out_of_scope cases; also report any nonaction separately.
metrics.semantic_coarse: Exact allowed intent/tool pair on 82 prelabelled actionable cases; implementation proxy, not capability correctness.
metrics.semantic_native: Exact native semantic intent/tool pair on 56 prelabelled actionable cases.
metrics.infrastructure: Missing/schema error/fallback counted incorrect in every fixed-denominator accuracy, reported separately.

predeclared_success_original: A3 mean binary accuracy > A1, A3 native semantic accuracy no more than 2 percentage points below A1, and A3 out_of_scope false-action rate < A1. Failure remains reported; no post-result tuning.
analysis: Same metrics as final-evaluation.json via the frozen analyze_router.py scoring functions; descriptive comparison with qwen2.5:7b, no new success criterion.
limitations: Author-created reused fixture, not held-out generalization.
Labels annotated by second AI agent, not human reviewer.
Only three repeats; 675 observations per arm are 225 repeated cases, not 675 independent cases.
Rule decisions bypass LLM and are reported separately. No actions, speech, GUI or deployment reliability measured.
Some actionable labels presume context absent from input; prelabelled sensitivity/exclusion notes preserved.
Prompt assembly is an experimental adapter; production route/rules/schema unchanged, sampling settings held constant.
Machine limitations frozen once; model computation uses shared local Ollama service; concurrent load cannot be fully excluded.
Prompts were written and frozen for qwen2.5:7b; not re-tuned for llama3.1:8b.
